topic: The last night bus on a mountain road: the passengers get off one by one at stops that are not on the map, and the bus has no driver.

episode.title: Midnight Watch: The Last Mountain Bus

shots.narration: The passengers left at stops that weren't on any map.
shots.scene: 3D animated film look, vertical 9:16, courtyard of an old Pakistani haveli at night, brass lantern between bashir and saad, no visible text.
shots.action: Bashir holds up an old brass bus token for Saad.
shots.mood: Warm lantern glow surrounded by deep blue fog and looming arches.

shots.narration: I boarded the last mountain bus, just before midnight.
shots.scene: Story flashback, isolated mountain road in Pakistan, weathered unmarked bus with an open rear entrance, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bashir steps onto the bus carrying his brass lantern.
shots.mood: Cold moonlight, steep roadside darkness, dim amber bus windows.

shots.narration: [whispers] Every seat was occupied, but nobody made a sound.
shots.scene: Old bus interior, bashir in the rear aisle, seat cushions deeply depressed beneath pools of dark mist, no human figures besides bashir, no text.
shots.action: Bashir raises his lantern toward the occupied-looking seats.
shots.mood: Dusty amber light, unnatural stillness, dense shadows filling each seat.

shots.narration: The first stop was a staircase ending in the clouds.
shots.scene: View through the open bus door, narrow stone steps rising from a mountain verge into moonlit cloud, no buildings or signs, vertical 9:16.
shots.action: A ribbon of dark mist streams from one depressed seat onto the steps.
shots.mood: Impossible height, pale clouds, black mountain silhouettes.

shots.narration: One seat emptied, though I never heard footsteps.
shots.scene: Close view of the vacated bus seat beside a fogged window, neighboring cushions still deeply depressed, no text.
shots.action: The empty seat cushion slowly rises back into shape.
shots.mood: Faded upholstery, trembling lantern reflections, enclosing darkness.

shots.narration: [surprised] My map showed only road, not a single stop.
shots.scene: Bus window seat, bashir holding a pictorial mountain map showing one uninterrupted road without symbols, letters, numbers or labels.
shots.action: Bashir traces the uninterrupted road with one finger.
shots.mood: Lantern-lit hands against a window filled with black cliffs.

shots.narration: The next door opened straight into a mountain wall.
shots.scene: Open bus doorway facing a sheer rock wall at arm's length, dim interior seats along the foreground, no text.
shots.action: Another ribbon of seat mist slips through the solid rock.
shots.mood: Wet stone, silver moonlight, an unnaturally deep doorway shadow.

shots.narration: At every impossible stop, another seat became empty.
shots.scene: Long view down the old bus aisle, all cushions restored except one depressed seat near the front, windows opaque with mountain fog.
shots.action: The final pool of dark mist drains beneath the closed exit door.
shots.mood: Abandoned rows, faint amber bulbs, heavy blue darkness.

shots.narration: [whispers] Then the bus stopped, and my door opened.
shots.scene: Bashir beside the rear exit, bottom step overlooking a sheer moonlit mountain drop, his lantern illuminating the threshold.
shots.action: The exit door folds open beside Bashir.
shots.mood: Bottomless fog, narrow amber threshold, stark cliffside moonlight.

shots.narration: I hurried forward to ask the driver where we were.
shots.scene: Empty bus aisle leading toward a tall driver's partition, rear doorway distant behind bashir, no labels or text.
shots.action: Bashir advances toward the driver's partition with his lantern.
shots.mood: Long seat shadows, tightening darkness, isolated lantern glow.

shots.narration: The wheel turned by itself; there was no driver.
shots.scene: Unobstructed view of an empty driver's seat and steering wheel, moonlit mountain road curving beyond the windshield, no mirrors reflecting figures, no text.
shots.action: The steering wheel turns sharply without anyone touching it.
shots.mood: Harsh moonlight exposes the empty seat above a fog-filled precipice.

shots.narration: [whispers] Tomorrow, Saad, I'll explain why that railway bell followed me.
shots.scene: Return to the haveli courtyard, bashir and saad beside the lantern, a small tarnished railway bell resting between them, no text.
shots.action: The railway bell swings without being touched.
shots.mood: Warm lantern light shrinking beneath vast arches and gathering night fog.

episode.endHook: Tomorrow night, the abandoned railway station rings its bell.
episode.description: By lantern light, Bashir Chacha tells Saad about a mountain bus whose passengers vanished at impossible stops. A fictional spooky story from Pakistan, where the last seat is never truly empty.
